answers.notes: We sell workflow software to logistics companies with 20 to 200 trucks. We have 310 customers at an average of $420 per month and 70% of them are on annual contracts. Monthly churn is about 1.4% and net expansion adds roughly 0.8% a month through extra seats. Marketing spend is $38,000 a month and a new customer costs about $2,900 to acquire. Hosting and third-party APIs take 9% of revenue, support costs $6 per customer per month. Engineering is 11 people, sales and marketing 6, customer success 4, finance and admin 2. We expect organic sign-ups to grow 20% a year and plan a Series A in 18 months, so we need a valuation-ready model.
